title: Derived Table (Subquery in FROM)
description: Find the top 3 highest-paid employees per department. Use a derived table with ROW_NUMBER() to rank employees within each department.
hints: First create a derived table with ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC)
Then in the outer query, filter WHERE rn <= 3
The derived table goes in the FROM clause as a subquery
